name: Calibre-Web
description: Calibre-Web, a browser page for a Calibre library: read, search and send books to an e-reader. It reads your books folder and never changes it.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

logo.alt: A book in a browser window

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins and in the Catalogue.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: Calibre-Web as a plug-in, outside the main install, on its own page on your home network.
